05/18.05.2023

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1394/2019, registered under Sections 498A/ 323/ 505 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Ms. Sakshi Srivastava, learned J.MF.C., Bermo at Tenughat.
This anticipatory bail application arises out of a complaint case.

Considering this fact, the petitioner, is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of the copy of this order and the learned court below on his surrender shall dispose of his bail application on the same day, in the lisght of the direction given in Birendra Jha @ Virendra Jha Vs. State of Jharkhand (2001 (2) JLJR 76) and also in the light of the direction given by the Hon'ble Apex Court in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Anr. 2022 LiveLaw (SC) 577.
